data.raw_text:
Idiotic proposal. At sino nagsabi sayo that TNTs in the U.S. can be legalized? 

Even Dreamers (innocent children brought illegally to USA by their parents) are not legalized. Adults pa kaya na may intent to stay illegally? 

The Philippines already gives tourists a way to extend their stay legally through tourist visa extensions for 1 to 6 months per renewal. Maximum 3 years stay, then they have to exit the country. 

These illegal aliens you’re talking about didn’t just violate immigration laws but also falsified documents so they can avoid paying visa extension fees and can do business as if they were locals and to avoid the 60/40 corporate ownership restriction. 

In the U.S., you will face deportation proceedings if you get caught as a TNT! 

And to get a U.S. conditional residency, you have to invest $800,000 USD if your business  is in a Targeted Employment Area (TEA) or $1,050,000 USD for standard investment. 

And you propose to just “excuse” these illegal aliens in the Philippines for ₱5 million or $80,000? 

What do you even mean by “legalize” them? Give them conditional residency? Residency? Citizenship? 

The better solution is to fire all corrupt immigration officials, file appropriate cases against the illegal aliens, then after they serve their sentences for the crimes they committed, subject them to deportation proceedings and give them a 10-year travel ban to the Philippines. 

They can re-enter the Philippines legally. 

Lawmaker ka tapos ikaw pa nag-iisip na gawing legal ang illegal.
